description_html:
Step Into Feudal Japan with 100 Large-Print Historical Word Searches

Immerse yourself in the legendary era of the samurai warlords, tranquil Zen monasteries, and the golden cultural renaissance of Kyoto. Between 1550 and 1650 AD, Japan transformed through dramatic Sengoku civil wars into two centuries of enduring peace under the Tokugawa Shogunate.

This masterfully crafted puzzle book brings ancient Kyoto to life through 100 thematic word search puzzles and 1,800 authentic historical terms.

What Makes This Volume Exceptional:

  • 100 Handcrafted Thematic Puzzles: Explore Nijo Castle, the three great unifiers (Nobunaga, Hideyoshi, Ieyasu), Zen rock gardens of Ryoan-ji, the tea mastery of Sen no Rikyu, and monumental gold screens of Kano Eitoku.
  • Easy-on-the-Eyes Large Print: Spacious 16x16 letter matrices set in high-contrast bold typography on soft cream paper for effortless, strain-free solving.
  • Collector's Cover Design: Authentic museum-grade classical Japanese painting, gilded accents, and high-visibility feature ribbons.
  • Historical Glossary & Chronology: Includes two dedicated reference pages defining key samurai and Buddhist terminology, plus a 12-milestone Sengoku-to-Edo historical timeline.
  • Thematic Directory: Complete five-part index organizing all 100 puzzles across Samurai Warlords, Imperial Temples, Zen & Tea Masters, Kano Gold Art, and Town Life.
  • Archival Registry Standard: Official imprint of TheBookGuy Press with permanent spatiotemporal classification code.

The definitive screen-free gift for history buffs, Japan travelers, martial artists, and puzzle lovers.
